mentions.name: CodeVibe
mentions.description: A vibe coding platform for creating personal apps that run entirely in chat, starting with WhatsApp. Beta users have built apps such as a wine inventory tracker, an outfit planner with a clothing inventory, a trip expenses tracker for groups of friends, and a personal training coach that tracks used muscle groups to eliminate muscle compensations. Beta access is being released to people on the waitlist.
mentions.audience: People who want personal apps for everyday life that they can use entirely through chat in WhatsApp
mentions.source_excerpt: This is the first vibe coding platform to create personal apps that run entirely on chat starting in WhatsApp.

evidence.value: This is the first vibe coding platform to create personal apps that run entirely on chat starting in WhatsApp.
